description: This file defines unsupported pandas-like window functions and classes for the pyspark.pandas library, specifically for expanding, rolling, and exponential moving window operations, including groupby variants.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeExpanding
classes.description: Represents unsupported expanding window functions for pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeRolling
classes.description: Represents unsupported rolling window functions for pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeExpandingGroupby
classes.description: Represents unsupported expanding window functions with groupby for pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeRollingGroupby
classes.description: Represents unsupported rolling window functions with groupby for pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeExponentialMoving
classes.description: Represents unsupported exponential moving window functions for pandas-on-Spark.

classes.name: MissingPandasLikeExponentialMovingGroupby
classes.description: Represents unsupported exponential moving window functions with groupby for pandas-on-Spark.
